title: Scenario DNA v0.2
description: Four-layer AV driving scenario ontology. v0.2 adds (additive over v0.1): a free-text scene_description for UI narrative + text embedding, a planner_logic.risk_level_rationale anchored to the ISO 21448:2022 SOTIF C x S rubric, and a generic planner_logic.safety_event channel (near-miss / hard-brake / evasive-swerve / collision). Enum sources: ASAM OpenSCENARIO v1.0 XSD, ASAM OSI v3.x, OpenDRIVE v1.5M XSD, WOD-E2E arXiv:2510.26125, PEGASUS 6LM arXiv:2012.06319, ISO 34502:2022, ISO 21448:2022 SOTIF. v0.2 reference standards: ISO 21448:2022 Sec.6 (C x S binary controllability x severity), NVIDIA Cosmos Dataset Search (CDS, 2025-Q4), VLM-AutoDrive (arXiv:2603.18178), Abbreviated Injury Scale (AIS) severity proxy.

scene_description.$comment: Free-text VLM-authored narrative: exactly 3 sentences, each <= ~200 chars, enforced at generation time via generation_schema(). The storage schema carries no maxLength so a complete third sentence is never amputated (relaxation of the former maxLength 500; every previously valid document remains valid). NOT derived from the structured topology/odd fields. No minLength constraint. Used for UI clip-detail narrative and as a high-signal input to the text embedding.

weather.$comment: Sources: ASAM OpenSCENARIO CloudState (overcast); ASAM OSI PrecipitationIntensity split (heavy_snow); ISO automotive taxonomy (sleet)

lighting.$comment: Sources: ASAM OSI AmbientIllumination lux-level buckets (dawn vs dusk operationally distinct; overcast_day ~100 lx vs full-sun day ~10000 lx)

sensor_fidelity.$comment: No authoritative standard defines these sensor degradation modes; domain-specific values retained.

road_type.$comment: Source: OpenDRIVE v1.5M XSD e_roadType. 'highway' replaced by 'motorway'; 'urban' split into primary/secondary; 'tunnel_road' removed (tunnel is an OpenDRIVE road object, not a type).

intersection_type.$comment: Source: OpenDRIVE junction types. 'direct_connection' = highway on/off-ramp merge zone (direct junction type).

actor_class.$comment: Sources: ASAM OSI VehicleClassification.Type (vehicle_car=TYPE_CAR, vehicle_van=TYPE_VAN, vehicle_construction=TYPE_WORK_MACHINE, standup_scooter_rider=TYPE_STANDUP_SCOOTER); ASAM PedestrianCategory (wheelchair_user); ASAM MiscObjectCategory (obstacle). vehicle_sedan+vehicle_suv consolidated to vehicle_car per OSI; escooter_rider renamed to standup_scooter_rider per OSI TYPE_STANDUP_SCOOTER. e_bike_rider, delivery_motorcycle, standup_scooter_rider retained for Korean urban road coverage.

ego_maneuver.$comment: Sources: WOD-E2E arXiv:2510.26125 Figure 4 (emergency_brake, swerve as distinct driving behaviors); PEGASUS HAD-F maneuver taxonomy (emergency braking as named category). emergency_brake = AEB/panic stop; brake_hard = intentional hard deceleration. swerve = lateral avoidance without completing a lane change.

risk_level.$comment: SOTIF mapping (ISO 21448): nominal=absence of unreasonable risk; elevated=tolerable with mitigation; critical=unreasonable risk (SOTIF trigger).

risk_level_rationale.$comment: One-sentence justification for the chosen risk_level, citing the ISO 21448:2022 Sec.6 C x S decision. Authored by the Scout (P4-2 prompt). For 'nominal' explains why no harm was reachable; for 'elevated'/'critical' cites the controllability margin / severity.

causal_trigger_actor_index.$comment: Index into actor_dynamics[]; null allowed in single-Scout era. Expected to be populated once Judge lands (post-v0.1).

safety_event.$comment: Generic curation-grade event channel (not accident-specific). Captures near-miss / hard-brake / evasive-swerve with the same fidelity as collision. Expected has_event=false and event_type=none on ~95% of routine clips. risk_level<->event_type semantic consistency is intentionally NOT enforced here (delegated to the P4-6 Judge critic); only the intra-object structural invariants below are enforced via if/then.

event_type.$comment: 'none' is the dominant value on routine traffic; 'near_miss'/'hard_brake' are the high Verify-by-Exception-value categories v0.1 could not express.

collision_type.$comment: Populated only when event_type=collision. Semantic distinction: 'none' is a positive determination (collision visible but not matching the taxonomy); null = unable to determine (off-screen / occluded / partial frame). When event_type!=collision this MUST be null (enforced by allOf if/then).

severity_estimate.$comment: Abbreviated-Injury-Scale-style proxy. null permitted if-and-only-if event_type=none (bidirectional, enforced by allOf if/then/else).

allOf.$comment: collision_type is null whenever event_type is not 'collision'.
severity_estimate is null iff event_type is 'none' (bidirectional).

scout_agreement.$comment: 1.0 for single Scout (no inter-model disagreement possible).

scout_prompt_hash.$comment: SHA256 of normalized prompt (whitespace-collapsed, CRLF->LF, trailing newline stripped).

judge_model.$comment: Populated by the P4-6 text-only Judge critic (qwen3-8b-awq). Null until the Judge re-scores the row.

reference_standards.$comment: Canonical value: see docs/implementation_plan.md provenance block. v0.2 additions: ISO 21448:2022 Sec.6, NVIDIA CDS (2025-Q4), VLM-AutoDrive (arXiv:2603.18178).
